knownDifferences.difference: Segmented Control shows five Label placeholder items in the source kit.
System controls are native macOS 27 source instances. Covio supplies only brand artwork and Covio data content.
Cross-page reactions do not run in Figma presentation mode. In-page reactions run.
The macOS host is SwiftUI and AppKit. It is not Compose Multiplatform. The Compose host stays for future Windows and Android targets. The visual result and the copy are unchanged.

The macOS host needs copy that no delivery page carries: the seven built-in hub tab names and their summaries, the top shelf window title and its errors, and the whole clipboard group. These entries have no Figma node. The values are the strings the SwiftUI host ships, taken verbatim, so adding them changes no visible text. They live here because the contract is the single source that every host reads copy from.

Figma component set 121:12394 is a horizontal six-item tab bar at 960 x 52. An earlier macOS build put those six tabs in a vertical floating rail at 200 x 370 with the page title in a separate top capsule. The retired Compose web preview (#107) restored the horizontal bar at the time, and the macOS host follows it: tab bar 960 x 46 at the top of the panel, page heading in its own row under it. The six items, their order, and their copy are unchanged.
The three hibernatemode option labels (0, 3, 25) were written in Swift and had no Figma node. They now live here as copy/general/sleep-mode/*. The values are unchanged.

Figma component set for the page title is 420 x 70 with the description stacked under the title. The macOS host puts the title and the description on one row under the tab bar, so the height is 24 and the description truncates first. The two strings and their copy keys are unchanged.
The Monitor Power management preview adds native-only copy for status, sessions, safety rules, and history. No delivery page carries these strings yet.

The offline Agent tab and chat interface have no Figma delivery page. The tab copy, local-service labels and confirmation copy live in the design contract. Light and dark previews are stored as 207-agent-tab-light-1.png and 207-agent-tab-dark-1.png.
The third file-area preview has no Figma delivery page. Its single focus, quiet grid, filter menu, empty state, and context menu are defined here from preview #201.

swiftMapping.behavior: 导航层叠在内容层上方，宽 960 点、高 46 点，使用无边框超薄材质。内容延伸到导航层背后，首屏内容从其下方开始。左端固定是 52 × 30 的文字首页入口，紧挨着 190 × 30 的单层 Liquid Glass 搜索框，中间是只显示文字的工作区页签（固定 72 × 30，胶囊圆角，间距 4；文字超长截断；默认六项直接显示，超过可用宽度时横向滚动），右端是固定宽度的动作位。导航按钮未选中时保持透明；选中、悬停或键盘聚焦时显示淡强调色胶囊填充。选中胶囊使用固定尺寸，不创建嵌套 Liquid Glass，也不参与外层 GlassEffectContainer 的合并。切换只淡入淡出，不改变导航按钮的位置或宽度。键盘焦点叠加高对比焦点环。页签文字字重固定，避免选中时改变宽度。搜索框使用原生 glassEffect 与系统清空动作。设置只保留工作区页签入口，其他工作区不显示右侧设置动作。编辑模式里页签前面加拖动把手，拖动跨过 76 点换一次位置。

rows.rationale: Adopt macOS switch proportions, state clarity, and direct manipulation. Keep Covio semantic colors and 44-point hit target.
rows.evidence: Static state comparison with macOS 27 (Community) switches and Covio/Switch variants. component/switch.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS field density and focus ring. Keep numeric input behavior and Covio validation copy.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with default, focused, error, and disabled HIG states. component/number-field.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS grouping and selection weight. Keep Covio radius, token colors, and compact widths.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with HIG segment spacing and selection treatment. component/segmented.

rows.rationale: Adapt hierarchy, shortcut alignment, and hover feedback. Use drawable Compose surfaces instead of system menu material.
rows.evidence: Static hierarchy comparison. The static menu hierarchy is present. component/tray-menu-item.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS message hierarchy and action order. Keep Covio semantic fills and accessible labels.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with macOS 27 (Community) alert structure and Covio alert variants. component/alert.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS title, body, and action grouping. Keep Covio focus order and loading behavior.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with macOS 27 (Community) dialog structure and the Covio modal board. component/dialog.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS compact hierarchy and icon alignment. Keep Covio status colors, duration, and dismissal rules.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with HIG notification density and Covio status variants. component/toast.

rows.rationale: Adopt macOS grouped settings hierarchy and row order. Keep Covio spacing, separators, and semantic tokens.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with settings boards and HIG grouped controls. component/card.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS anchor relationship and compact content. Use an editable static material layer.
rows.evidence: Static structure comparison. The static anchoring geometry is present. component/popover.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS icon weight, spacing, and grouping. Keep Covio positioning, drag behavior, and collection motion.
rows.evidence: Static comparison with HIG toolbar buttons and Covio toolbar boards. component/toolbar.

rows.rationale: Adapt macOS window hierarchy and traffic-light placement. Use editable vector layers for the static window shell.
rows.evidence: Static comparison only. The static window geometry is present. component/window-shell.

rows.rationale: Adapt item order, hit area, and status feedback. Do not copy Apple branding or system menu resources.
rows.evidence: Static component comparison only. The static menu-bar geometry is present. component/tray-icon.

rows.rationale: Use standard Sequoia materials with blur, opacity, borders, and shadows.
rows.evidence: Static material comparison. The static material hierarchy is present. component/material.

rows.rationale: Adopt semantic roles and light-dark mapping. Covio keeps its own brand and status values.
rows.evidence: Variable audit across both collections and static board comparison. token/color/brand.

rows.evidence: Six local styles audited with zero missing fonts and no real clipping. text-style/covio.

platform/component/window-bar.behavior: Keep traffic-light controls at the leading edge and place title content after them.

platform/component/page-title.behavior: 页标题 18 点半粗加说明 11 点次要色，底部对齐排一行，间距 10 点。行高 24 点，宽度等于内容列 912 点。右端可以挂当前页的动作。

platform/component/tab-bar.behavior: Keep one selected item, expose keyboard focus, and disable unavailable destinations.

platform/component/card.behavior: Use surface, divider, and large radius tokens; do not nest cards.

platform/component/bento-grid.behavior: 四列网格，行高 96 点，间距 12 点，列宽 (912 − 12 × 3) / 4 = 219 点。卡片保存列、行和尺寸。编辑模式拖动显示目标格；占用区与越界区拒绝放置。方向键和无障碍动作可按格移动卡片。

platform/component/widget-card.behavior: 圆角 16 点，底色取各自的 token/color/widget-tint-*，内边距 14 点，标题 13 点半粗，下面一行 11 点次要色。四档尺寸：小 1×1、宽 2×1、高 1×2、大 2×2。

platform/component/setting-row.behavior: Keep the control target at least 44 points and align the label at the leading edge.

platform/component/switch.behavior: Expose checked state to accessibility services and keep the full row clickable.

platform/component/number-field.behavior: Clamp values to the documented range and keep the error text visible.

platform/component/segmented.behavior: Expose one selected value and support keyboard movement between options.

platform/component/button.behavior: Allow one submission per press and keep loading, success, warning, and error labels visible.

platform/component/badge.behavior: Pair every color with text or an icon so color is not the only status cue.

platform/component/alert.behavior: Keep the message in reading order before related actions.

platform/component/dialog.behavior: Trap keyboard focus, restore focus on close, and keep the primary action visible.

platform/component/toast.behavior: Do not put the only recovery action in a toast; keep it announced to assistive technology.

platform/component/screenshot-card.behavior: Show screenshots as file-area focus or quiet tiles. Expose copy, open, markup, workspace, and remove actions.

platform/component/tray-menu-item.behavior: Use the macOS menu surface and system keyboard behavior.

platform/component/clothespin.behavior: Use the shared glass hanger icon. Do not draw rope or clothesline geometry.

platform/component/tray-icon.behavior: StatusItemController 使用原生 NSStatusItem，并加载 CovioStatusIcon 的预渲染位图。图标位置由 macOS 菜单栏系统排列。运行时复用缓存位图，不计算渐变和阴影。左键开合 Hub，右键开菜单。

platform/component/tray-menu.behavior: Use the native menu implementation; do not draw alternate menu chrome.

platform/system/menus.behavior: Use system menu controls, keyboard behavior, materials, and accessibility.

platform/system/materials.behavior: Figma uses native macOS 27 material layers. Compose uses drawable approximations.

platform/system/accessibility.runtimeTarget: Compose semantics and macOS accessibility bridge
platform/system/accessibility.behavior: Keep focus, names, values, and reduced-motion behavior available to assistive technology.

platform/component/material.behavior: Use drawable translucent fills, borders, and shadows.

platform/component/window-shell.behavior: Use the shared shell. The Hub content plate uses Liquid Glass; the system material is a debug fallback.

platform/component/toolbar.behavior: Use the native-aligned control height, spacing, and state model.

platform/component/popover.behavior: Use the 10-point popover radius and the native focus-return rule.

platform/component/file-area.behavior: One filter menu, one Add button, one focus card, and a quiet four-column grid.

platform/component/file-focus-card.behavior: Full-width detailed item with preview and compact actions.

platform/component/file-quiet-tile.behavior: Content-first grid tile with one primary action on hover.

platform/component/file-filter-menu.behavior: Single menu for All, Screenshots, Files, Text, and Transfers.

platform/component/file-context-menu.behavior: Native menu rhythm with destructive action last.
